First time? Here's the drill

a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace

Check

About the Big Wheel Bikes CV Community Group Rides group ride

An independent Coachella Valley shop that runs guided community group rides, demo days and bike nights during the cool season. The Palm Springs store closes for summer. Rides are announced on Facebook and Instagram rather than a standing schedule.
